title: Artificial Intelligence to Predict the BRAF V595E Mutation in Canine Urinary Bladder Urothelial Carcinomas
summary: U-Net analysis of H&E slides predicts PCR-confirmed canine BRAF V595E mutation in a held-out set of 84 cases; sensitivity/specificity are modest and materially depend on tissue quality, so the finding is a bounded veterinary diagnostic proof of concept. PCR is a reference standard in a case-held-out validation set; performance is limited (57/96 agreement; 58% sensitivity, 63% specificity) and quality-dependent, with no external site validation.
ai_technology: Visiopharm decision-forest tissue segmentation and U-Net tumor segmentation/mutation prediction operate on H&E whole-slide images, trained against ddPCR and compared with PCR in held-out cases.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The result is prediction of a molecular tumor mutation from routine histology images, a specific diagnostic application; BRAF mutation itself was known before this paper.
evidence.unknown: PCR is a reference standard in a case-held-out validation set; performance is limited (57/96 agreement; 58% sensitivity, 63% specificity) and quality-dependent, with no external site validation. The source does not establish benefits beyond the reported evaluation.
